'''Maiya Vix''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] as part of the [[Dread Executioners]] strike force under Lord [[Hargrev]]. She assisted Hargrev and the Imperial forces during the [[Dread War]] on [[Oricon]].<ref name="MR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maiya Vix is a character in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', voiced by [[Lydia Leonard]]. She appears during the Imperial world arc on [[Oricon]], released with game update 2.4 in [[2013]].

In the Imperial storyline of ''Legacy Reborn'', the finale of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|Legacy of the Sith]]'' expansion, Maiya Vix participates in the [[Battle of Khar Shian]], commanding the Empire's forces in space alongside [[Darth Acina|Empress Acina]] or [[Darth Vowrawn|Emperor Vowrawn]].<ref name="Legacy Reborn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Legacy Reborn|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref>
